title: pi-9router config
description: <agent-dir>/extensions/9router.json. Secret-free: the API key lives in auth.json as the 9router login credential (ROUTER_API_KEY overrides it).

$schema.description: Editor JSON Schema reference; not a runtime setting.

baseUrl.description: 9Router OpenAI-compatible base URL, e.g. https://router.example/v1. A trailing slash is stripped. When absent, ROUTER_API_BASE is used; there is no built-in endpoint.

comboReasoning.description: Reasoning for combo models (owned_by "combo"), which carry no capabilities from the router. true enables the full off..max range, false disables reasoning, an object overrides the thinking level map.

thinkingLevelMap.description: Pi thinking level to the router's reasoning_effort value; null hides that level. Omitted uses {"xhigh": "xhigh", "max": "max"}.

tools.description: Per-tool switches for the bundled tools; each defaults to on, set false to disable.
